_note: CIDs already contacted. The scorer excludes every cid listed here, so a business you have already called never reappears on a call sheet. Add the cid (the `cid` column in leads.csv, e.g. "0x396302af45d8f831:0x594d8a0f1d292998") after you speak to someone. This file is the operator's memory between runs — it is the difference between a lead list and the same lead list again next month.
_format: cids: array of cid strings. Comments live in _note keys and are ignored.
